data.name: Nodwar
data.detailed_description:
Command nations. Shape worlds. Dominate in real time.

NODWAR is a real-time strategy platform that gives you everything from quick arcade conquests to massive grand strategy campaigns — all in one seamless package. Whether you want a fast 10-minute session or hours of deep planetary empire-building, you choose the intensity.

Three Distinct Ways to Play

Classic — Arcade Strategy

Fast-paced node conquest. Merge territories, sabotage enemies, and climb the leaderboard in short, addictive matches. Perfect when you want action without the long commitment.

Aeon — Grand Strategy

Drop into a living, procedurally generated planet alongside hundreds of AI nations. Expand your borders, manage your economy, research technologies across the ages, and lead your people to global supremacy. Build cities and factories, command fleets, fortify defenses, and make tough diplomatic decisions in a breathing world simulation.

Grand strategy that feels epic but stays approachable — meaningful choices that matter without overwhelming complexity.

Crux — Real Time Strategy

Take direct command on the battlefield. Lead squads of infantry, tanks, and specialized units in intense ground combat. Build bases, execute flanking maneuvers, and fight decisive tactical engagements.

What You Can Expect

  • Massive Seamless Maps — Smooth, organic territory expansion that creates natural frontlines and strategic depth.

  • Technology & Progression — Advance through eras of human development, unlocking new units, buildings, and capabilities.

  • Rich Empire Building — Construct cities, industrial centers, ports, missile silos, and defensive networks.

  • Naval & Strategic Warfare — Control the seas, launch invasions, and wield powerful weapons when needed.

  • Smart AI Opponents — Nations that remember alliances, rivalries, and betrayals.

  • Deterministic Multiplayer — Jump in with friends or strangers on the same massive maps with rock-solid sync.

  • Singleplayer Focused — Fully playable offline against AI, with deep simulation running locally.

  • True Strategy — Focused on real strategy like logistics, information, vision, and high-level decisions rather than overwhelming micro-management.

  • Constant Pressure — No turns, no game speed controls, you won't fall asleep here, everything happens in real-time, and you must adapt to circumstances as they happen.

No microtransactions. No pay-to-win. No endless DLCs.

This is a complete, fair experience — free to play, with everything unlocked through gameplay and skill. We’re committed to delivering a full strategy game without nickel-and-diming players.

NODWAR is built for strategy fans who love watching their empire grow from a single foothold into a planetary superpower. Accessible enough for newcomers, deep enough for veterans.

No bloat. Just pure strategic satisfaction.
